description: Na₃GdBr₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with nine NaBr₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent GdBr₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-60°. There are three shorter (2.91 Å) and three longer (3.01 Å) Na-Br bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent GdBr₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-60°. There are three shorter (2.92 Å) and three longer (3.03 Å) Na-Br bond lengths. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form distorted NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent GdBr₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one GdBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-56°. There are three shorter (2.93 Å) and three longer (3.05 Å) Na-Br bond lengths. Gd³⁺ is bonded to six Br¹⁻ atoms to form GdBr₆ octahedra that share corners with nine NaBr₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-56°. There are three shorter (2.82 Å) and three longer (2.85 Å) Gd-Br bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Br¹⁻ sites. In the first Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na¹⁺ and one Gd³⁺ atom. In the second Br¹⁻ site, Br¹⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Gd³⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing BrNa₃Gd trigonal pyramids.
